units.source_text: 你也许会取笑这是太古时代的人或未开化民族的泛神论。

en.t: You may laugh at this as the pantheism of people from ancient times or of uncivilized peoples.

units.source_text: 不过，你若深入探索，应该说这是科学家进行创造的物质的根源。

en.t: But if you explore it deeply, it should be called the root of the matter from which scientists create.

units.source_text: 那么，越探索不是越能了解这种东西是流转在万物之间了吗。

en.t: Then, the more you explore, do you not come to understand all the more that this kind of thing circulates among all things?

units.source_text: 据说，在这个世界上失去形态的东西的香气，会形成另一个世界的物质。

en.t: It is said that the fragrance of things that lose their form in this world becomes the substance of another world.

units.source_text: 这种说法，只不过是科学思想的象征之歌罢了。

en.t: This way of saying it is nothing more than a symbolic song of scientific thought.

units.source_text: 连我这个才疏学浅的年轻女子，也都领悟到物质的根本或力量是不灭的。

en.t: Even I, a young woman of little talent and shallow learning, have come to understand that the root or force of matter is imperishable.

units.source_text: 为什么必须考虑只有灵魂的力量会熄灭呢？

en.t: Why must we think that only the power of the soul will be extinguished?

units.source_text: 灵魂这个词，难道不是天地万物流动力量的形容词吗？

en.t: Is the word soul not an adjective for the power that flows through heaven, earth, and all things?
